freelancers.bio: Ex-Razorpay engineer specializing in high-throughput payment systems, real-time dashboards, and performant Next.js applications.

projects.title: Build B2B SaaS Customer Portal with Razorpay Integration
projects.description: Looking for an experienced Indian full-stack developer to architect and build our client billing and order tracking workspace. Milestones funded via escrow.

projects.title: Complete Figma Design System for Healthcare Mobile App
projects.description: Need an end-to-end Figma UI/UX specification with atomic components for iOS and Android telemedicine app catering to Indian regional users.

projects.title: Cross-Platform Flutter Delivery Partner Application
projects.description: Hyperlocal delivery fleet app with live GPS tracking, OTP delivery confirmation, UPI payment collection, and multilingual support.

projects.title: Quarterly GST & TDS Filing + Accounting Reconciliation
projects.description: Seeking a verified CA or tax consultant to reconcile annual purchases against GSTR-2B, file GSTR-1 & 3B, and prepare 26AS TDS returns.

proposals.coverLetter: I specialize in Indian FinTech and high-performance logistics platforms. Built real-time route optimization systems handling 100k+ packages/day. I will structure the project into 3 verified milestones.

milestones.title: Milestone 3: Driver App Integration & Load Testing

proposals.coverLetter: Experienced with ABDM (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) compliance, HL7/FHIR protocols, and WebRTC encrypted teleconsultations. Happy to demo our previous healthcare deployment.
Senior Mobile Engineer with 6+ years React Native & iOS experience. Ready to deliver ABDM M1/M2/M3 compliance with clean native bridges.

milestones.title: Milestone 1: Architecture & Auth Setup
milestones.description: Database schemas, RBAC middleware, and Next.js foundation

deliverable.freelancerNotes: Full setup complete with PR merged and staging deployed.
deliverable.clientFeedback: Excellent architectural layout. Approved for payment release.

milestones.title: Milestone 2: Payment Gateway & Escrow Integration
milestones.description: Razorpay Route adapter, webhooks, and billing dashboard

milestones.title: Milestone 3: End-to-End QA & Production Handover
milestones.description: Final security audit and production release
